species: Diplonema papillatum (ATCC 50162) was originally obtained from the American Type Culture Collection (ATCC) and cultivated axenically without shaking at 15–22°C in ocean salt medium (OS) containing 33 g/l Instant Ocean Sea Salt (Instant Ocean) and supplemented with 1% (v/v) horse serum as described earlier.
